_doc: Animals of the archipelago. hp: how hard they are to bring down (a stone knife hit takes 0.3, a spear 0.6). speed / run: m/s wandering and fleeing. size: [width, height] of the body (for hits and leading). shy: how close you can come before they run. shore: keeps to the sand at the water's edge. lead: can be led on twine (and so taken across the sea on a raft). eats: what they take from your hand; two fed animals together make a young one. isles: island kinds they live on, with how many [min, max] per island. drops: as for blocks.
